description.value:
The addition of wings or small magical devices lets this pawn take to the skies. It has a fly Speed equal to its land Speed.

Simplified: DESIGN.md gates this by the pawn's size and the maestro's level (Small or smaller always, Medium at 12th, Large at 16th); here it's granted unconditionally once installed, since pawns are Small by default and the size gate rarely matters in practice.
